Meet Urban Sports Club
We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.
But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities .
*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.
The opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Growth Operations team to build and scale the marketing technology and automation layer powering Urban Sports Club's B2C growth.
This role sits at the intersection of CRM, marketing technology, and data activation, with a primary focus on enabling and scaling our CRM infrastructure while extending its impact across paid acquisition, product, and partnerships.
You will act as the system owner and enabler, ensuring our tools, automation, and data are fully leveraged to drive efficient, personalized, and scalable growth.

You own the CRM infrastructure, optimizing Braze for scalability, lifecycle automation, and personalization
You build and scale automated CRM and marketing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort
You activate customer data by partnering with Segment to enable real-time audiences and data-driven growth use cases
You extend CRM audiences across paid marketing channels to drive retargeting, suppression, and lookalike strategies
You manage and integrate the MarTech stack, establishing best practices, governance, and scalable processes
You drive AI adoption by implementing use cases that enhance CRM, content creation, workflows, and personalization
You collaborate with growth, product, and partnership teams to deliver impactful, cross-channel customer activation
What you will need to succeed
You have 4–7+ years of experience in MarTech, CRM Operations, or Marketing Operations
You have hands-on experience with Braze, Segment, or similar CRM and customer data platforms
You have a strong understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lifecycle marketing
You have experience working with marketing data, audience segmentation, and customer activation
You have a solid technical foundation, including APIs, integrations, and data flows.
You bring a problem-solving mindset with a focus on scalability, efficiency, and process optimization
You are passionate about applying AI to improve marketing workflows, automation, and personalization
What's in it for you
Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.
Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

Are you a seasoned product manager looking to build experiences that millions of people rely on to discover new ways to make a living with Uber? Are you energized by creating user journeys where magical experiences, growth, and trust must work hand in hand? If so, this role might be for you.
As a Lead Product Manager your impact on the business side, onboarding, and making new drivers successful is the lifeblood that powers Uber's growth and creates a path to economic empowerment for millions of people every year.
In this role, you will envision and deliver a multi-gig experience that is intuitive, fast, globally scalable and tailored to different earner segments. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how drivers and couriers discover new earning opportunities, maximize their earnings and manage their platform access across all of their gigs.
This role requires strong product sense, a good understanding of the driver persona and their motivations and great crossfunctional agility. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, operations, legal, and trust & safety partners to build experiences that support and scale with the speed of our business.

The Earner growth team sits at the heart of the earner lifecycle and plays a foundational role in Uber's global growth. We are responsible for maximizing the number of quality, high performing earners on the platform.

We achieve this through optimizing the onboarding experience, enabling earners to progress during their early lifecycle and by helping to maximize their earning potential through multiple gigs to increase retention. In the event that earners churn, we also focus on bringing them back to the platform.

Own the product roadmap and lead vision, definition and execution for building Uber's earner multi gig experience.
Rethink the journey - deeply understand earners, their motivations and challenges and keep making the gig discovery and recommendation experience better.
Innovate - find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.
Distill vision and strategy for the team, get all members of cross-functional team #superpumped.
Own your numbers, drive your cross-functional team of engineers, data scientist, product ops and designers to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals -- and overachieve them.
Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to leadership.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience.
Experience delivering highly successful and creative consumer Internet products with your fingerprints all over them - you're proud of what you've accomplished.
Data-driven: you always get the data you need, and you can distill it into an insightful story. Most importantly, you leverage data to drive strategic decisions.
Technical skills. Ability to inform and evaluate engineering decisions.

Any experience working with gig economy earners
Launching products in different international markets
Experience in building and optimizing complex user acquisition funnels or recommendation engines
~~ ~~

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.
Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.
This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.
Tasks
Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.
Help maintain and organize the product backlog.
Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.
Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.
Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.
Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.
Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

s.h: Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.
s.t:
Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.
Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.
Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.
Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.
Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.
The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.
Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.
Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.
A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.
Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.
Helpful, but not required
Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.
Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.
Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.
You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

s.h: What success looks like within your first six months
s.t:
Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.
Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.
Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.
Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.
Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.
The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.
You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

Monthly learning budget

Who we are
Employment Hero is on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into an all-in-one solution.
Since our inception in 2014, we’ve scaled to a $2 billion valuation and gained a presence in 6 countries globally - Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK and Canada. We now service over 300,000 businesses and more than 2 million employees.
The EH Way
At Employment Hero, we’re proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way.
We are Mission First - everything we do (from what we work on, to how we allocate capital and where we focus) is driven by our Mission
We are Remote First - we champion a remote environment with a preference for asynchronous communication and a high degree of autonomy
We are AI First - we are committed to using AI to accelerate our mission; AI is not just a tool, it’s a fundamental part of how we operate, innovate, and scale
We are Apolitical - we do not take a position on political or social topics, unless it relates to our Mission
We Live by Our Values - we role model our values 100% of the time
We Expect High Performance - we set a high standard and we’re not satisfied with being average
This role
This role will be hyper-focused on the payroll aspect of our product, specifically building the infrastructure and feature set to support small and medium-sized businesses. We offer an all-in-one solution with a hub-and-spoke modular product. One of the key spokes of our product offering is payroll, which includes facilitating payments, keeping records, and calculating and remitting taxes.
In addition, supporting decision-makers with critical data and analytics is key for further unlocking areas of innovation across all pillars (HR, Payroll, Benefits, and Scheduling).
Be responsible for product delivery, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and cross-functional coordination.
Define the scope of development for new product features and ongoing feature enhancements.
Write and prioritize epics, user stories, and define acceptance criteria.
Establish and maintain a high level of credibility with internal and external stakeholders.
Leverage your analytical ability to back your decisions with data.
Effectively use data and analytics layered against high-quality user research to inform the direction of the product line.
Be responsible for tracking progress, assessing risks, coordinating delivery, and actively communicating contingency and mitigation plans for the team.
You will run various ad-hoc research and business analyses to assess opportunities and risks.

s.h: What are we looking for in a Product Owner?
s.t:
3+ years of Product Management experience with a SaaS product, ideally related to Canadian payroll offerings
Experience working in fintech, payment, payroll, reporting, or analytics.
Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows to articulate ideas to cross-functional teams.
Detail-oriented with a high bar for quality when writing PRDs, user stories, reviewing designs, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams.
World-class individual contributor and team player to thrive at Employment Hero.
Ability to influence others through leadership and strong communication skills.
Ability to keep up in a fast-paced and pivot in a dynamic environment.

s.h: Bonus points if you have experience with
s.t:
Workplace experience leveraging AI in Product Management to boost productivity as an individual contributor.
You have a passion for the HR tech space.
You’ve worked in a cross-functional team previously where you and your squad took ownership of the success of an area of focus.

s.h: In short, you’ll love working with us if
s.t:
Revolutionizing employment gets your heart racing.
You thrive on the flexibility (and responsibility) of a remote-first business.

s.h: Our values align, and shape how you show up every day.
s.t:
You love the dynamic pace of a startup, are driven by innovation, and enjoy working with other smart people.
What we can offer
At Employment Hero, we don’t just talk about a better way to work - we live it. Joining Employment Hero means
You will work remotely, with the flexibility to own your time and impact
You will access cutting-edge tools to amplify your work, knowledge and outputs
You’ll surround yourself with ambitious, outcome-driven colleagues who challenge you to do the best work of your life
Remote & Flexible working. Work from wherever you do your best
You’ll also have access to a wide range of benefits that includes - a very generous parental & carers leave policy, a WFH office allowance, De Minimis Allowance (per month), private health & life insurance cover and outstanding learning & development opportunities

Willkommen bei baramundi! "Wo Cloud, Security und Daten zusammenkommen, entsteht die Zukunft unserer Produkte"
Der Software-Markt entwickelt sich rasant weiter – und wir gestalten diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. Für unser Research & Development suchen wir einen Product Owner oder eine Product Ownerin, der bzw. die gemeinsam mit einem festen Entwicklungsteam unsere Cloud-Lösungen weiter voranbringt und den baramundi Proactive Hub im Bereich Big Data & Security maßgeblich mitgestaltet.
Am Standort Augsburg arbeiten interdisziplinäre Teams aus Softwareentwicklung, Testing, Scrum Mastering, Product Ownership und Agile Coaching an den Software-Produkten von morgen – zu 100 Prozent made in Germany. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Anforderungen zu verwalten, sondern Produktideen in klare, umsetzbare Schritte zu übersetzen, technische Komplexität greifbar zu machen und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden zu schaffen.
Neben einem großartigen Team bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten, aktiv an der Produktentwicklung mitzuwirken und deine Ideen jederzeit einzubringen.
Tu, was du am besten kannst: SECURITY & COMPLIANCE INTELLIGENCE VORANTREIBEN Du verantwortest die Security-Säule des baramundi Proactive Hub – von Vulnerability Intelligence über Configuration Management bis hin zu Infrastructure Analytics. Du übersetzt komplexe Sicherheitsanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Produktinkremente und stellst sicher, dass IT-Teams proaktiv über Risiken informiert und handlungsfähig gemacht werden
DATA LAKEHOUSE & BIG DATA MITGESTALTEN Du treibst gemeinsam mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam den Aufbau einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren Dateninfrastruktur voran – als Core-Enabler für alle datengetriebenen Features des Proactive Hub. Dabei bringst du die Verarbeitungsgeschwindigkeit und -qualität unserer Daten auf ein neues Level
PLATFORM & INTEGRATIONS WEITERENTWICKELN Du gestaltest den Ausbau der Proactive Hub Plattform aktiv mit – durch Integration externer Tools, Drittsysteme und Schnittstellen mit dem Ziel, den Hub zum zentralen Knotenpunkt im IT-Management-Ökosystem unserer Kunden zu machen
KI ALS PRODUKTBESTANDTEIL DENKEN Du gestaltest KI-gestützte Features aktiv mit – von intelligenter Anomalieerkennung über LLM-basierte Assistenzfunktionen bis hin zu datengetriebenen Empfehlungen, die IT-Administratoren proaktiv und handlungsfähig machen
MIT DEINEM TEAM LIEFERN Du arbeitest eng mit deinem festen Entwicklungsteam zusammen, bist deren primäre Ansprechperson für inhaltliche und produktbezogene Fragen und stellst sicher, dass das Team fokussiert, informiert und befähigt arbeiten kann
BRÜCKE ZWISCHEN PM UND ENTWICKLUNG SEIN Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product Manager und UX/Design zusammen, moderierst Anforderungsprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass die Produktvision im Entwicklungsalltag greifbar und umsetzbar bleibt
BACKLOG MIT KLARHEIT FÜHREN Du priorisierst und pflegst den Product Backlog in Azure DevOps, formulierst präzise Akzeptanzkriterien und Definition of Done und sorgst für Transparenz über Ziele und Fortschritt
SPASS HABEN Du findest deinen Platz in einem vielfältigen, kollegialen Umfeld und freust dich darauf, ein spannendes Cloud-Produkt im Schnittfeld von Security, Big Data und KI mitzugestalten
Bring mit, was wir an dir schätzen: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationssicherheit oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation aus der Praxis
Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren produktverantwortlichen Rolle
Kenntnisse oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an IT-Security, Vulnerability Management oder Big Data / Datenplattformen
Grundlegendes Verständnis von KI-Technologien und deren Einsatz im Produktkontext – z.B. ML-basierte Analysen, LLM-gestützte Assistenzfunktionen oder datengetriebene Empfehlungssysteme
Grundlegendes Verständnis von Cloud-Architekturen und SaaS-Produktentwicklung (idealerweise Azure)
Fähigkeit, technische Komplexität zu durchdringen und in verständliche, priorisierbare Anforderungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) und Backlog-Tools, idealerweise Azure DevOps
Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken, datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung und hoher Qualitätsanspruch
Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch und Englisch
Bonus: Background in IT-Administration oder IT-Security, Erfahrung mit Enterprise-IT-Umgebungen oder praktische Kenntnisse in Angular bzw. modernen Frontend-Technologien
So ticken wir!

Who is Credible ?
Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.
About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler.

Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant. Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs. Responsibilities:
Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

🌎 What we do
We build software to enable sustainable agriculture supply chains.
~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator.

Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met.

Enterprise software and new business processes can help - to make processes in the day-to-day more efficient, connect farmers better to their partners and thus, enable action in supply chains.
We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early stage tech team in Europe.
Today Root is the #1 primary data collection platform for dairy in DACH. We are AI-enabled at the core and driving the AI transformation across the food and agri world. The next chapter is bigger.
🔭 What you will work on

Build an innovative operating system for the dairy industry from 0 to 1, at the intersection of farmers and dairies. Dairy is Root's home market. We know it inside out - the players, the workflows, the technology gaps, the people. We see a category-defining opportunity to build a new product line that sits between farmers and dairy processors, and that has the potential to become the connecting piece of our portfolio.
This is a genuinely greenfield role. You will not inherit a backlog. You will define what we build, why, and for whom - then prove it works with a handful of pilot customers before we scale.

s.h: What your job will look like
s.t:
Run deep discovery. Spend weeks with farmers, farm technicians, milk procurement teams, and dairy executives on-site. Understand their jobs, KPIs, and frustrations from the inside.
Define new workflows together with our customers. Shape how dairy companies will work in the future. This product line is about setting a new standard, not digitising what already exists - while AI will be at the core of it.
Build hacky prototypes and run pilots. Show, do not tell. Get something tangible in front of 2-3 design partners within weeks.
Assess desirability, feasibility, and viability before we commit serious engineering investment.
Define the v1 spec with engineering and design once we have conviction. Set the team up for delivery.
Onboard the first paying customers and iterate fast. Own the loop.
Decide what we will NOT build. Scope discipline is critical with limited engineering capacity and a customer base that operates on a fixed annual cycle.
You will work side by side with the Head of Product to make the bet, and own the product line end-to-end as it grows. Engineering and design support will scale with traction.

s.h: What success looks like at 6 months
s.t:
A first end-to-end prototype tested with real customers
3 signed Letters of Intent from new customers
A concrete, evidence-backed set of build hypotheses for v1
🦾 How we support you
You will report directly to our Head of Product.

You have built a product line or a major module from 0 to 1 - not just iterated on an existing one. You can talk us through what worked, what did not, and what you learned.
You love discovery. Customer interviews, field research, prototyping, and pilots are your favourite part of the job, not the part you outsource.
You love observing how others do their job. You take the parts that matter, design new workflows around them, and put prototypes in front of users to iterate - rather than running survey-driven roadmaps.
You are AI-fluent. Modern AI tools are part of your daily craft - for discovery synthesis, prototyping, writing, coding. You also have a point of view on how AI reshapes the products we build.

**Was kann ich bewirken?**
Ein grosser Industriekunde wünscht sich eine verbesserte Suche. An einem Workshop holst du gemeinsam mit unserem Team die relevanten Use-Cases ab. Du skizzierst Optionen, welche LLM, Live-Suche und eine intuitive Filterung beinhalten. Später spezifizierst du deren Funktionsweise im Detail, koordinierst die Lösung mit den Entwickelnden und testest sie.
Ein NGO nutzt ein HR-Tool und möchte erfahren, ob und wie dieses in ihre Website eingebunden werden kann. Du zeigst die relevanten technischen Optionen auf mit Vor- und Nachteilen und Konsequenzen.
Mit deiner (noch) unvoreingenommenen Aussenperspektive hinterfragst du unsere aktuellen Kundenprojekte aktiv und faktenbasiert: Was sollten wir optimieren, damit diese das Ziel unserer Kunden und ihrer User noch besser erfüllen?
Kurz: Du denkst und spezifizierst Lösungen, die Menschen nicht nur entlasten, sondern begeistern.
**Who the Hell is Helga?**
Wir stehen am Morgen auf, um die Welt an diesem Tag einen kleinen Schritt effizienter, userfreundlicher und damit besser zu machen. Um am Abend etwas dazugelernt und gemeinsam eine gute Zeit verbracht zu haben.
Das tun wir als 11-köpfige Berner Digitalagentur, indem wir Web-basierte Lösungen entwickeln, welche das digitale Morgen prägen. Indem wir mutig denken. Indem wir als zuverlässiger Partner etwas Konkretes bewirken. Mit höchsten Ansprüchen an User-Experience, Technologie und uns selber.
Mit dem Anspruch, Kunden zu begeistern und ihre User umzuhauen.
**Was erwartet ihr von mir?**
Vor allem: Die Fähigkeit, umwerfende Lösungen zu entwickeln - und logisches Denken. Zudem: Affinität zu Software und Erfahrung mit Product Development und Requirements Engineering.
*Kompetenzen*

s.h: Here-s the catch - du vereinigst zwei Widersprüche
s.t:
* Einerseits Ideation: Du denkst mutig und offen und schnell, bist kreativ und nimmst unerwartete Perspektiven ein. Damit findest und skizzierst du Lösungen, welche das Ordinäre sprengen.
* Andererseits arbeitest du strukturiert, logisch und mit einem Blick fürs Detail. Damit dokumentierst du deine Lösungen so, dass unsere technologiefernen Kunden sie verstehen und unsere Software-Entwickelnden diese umsetzen können.
* Du musst Menschen nicht lieben - aber ausgezeichnet mit ihnen umgehen können, locker und seriös gleichzeitig. Du kannst sie abholen, wo sie gerade sind und dahin führen, wo du sie begeistern kannst.
*Hintergrund*
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von (digitalen) Produkten, mit Business Analysis, Product Ownership oder Requirements Engineering.
* Datenmodellierung, Schnittstellendefinitionen, User Story Writing, Spezifikationen und Wireframing sind dein Werkzeugkasten.
* Digitales und sein Potential begeistern dich. Du bringst ein tiefes technologisches Verständnis mit: Was ist ein CMS (und wo gliedert sich da Drupal ein), was heisst serverseitiges Rendering, was ist eine relationale Datenstruktur? Geschenkt.
* Keine Sorge, Französisch ist nicht nötig. Aber: Dein Deutsch ist ausgezeichnet und dein gesprochenes Englisch solide (ja, für alles Schriftliche gibt-s LLMs).
*Charakter*
* Du hast Bock, mit einem motivierten Team zusammen zu wachsen, dieses mitzuprägen und darin Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Du brüskierst dich an unklaren Ansagen und wirst ungeduldig bei langwierigen Meetings.
* Du erkennst Herausforderungen und gehst sie aktiv an. Du suchst und siehst Potential, nicht Probleme.
* Du willst nicht nur digitale Lösungen, sondern auch dich weiterentwickeln. Und im besten Fall die Agentur gleich mit.
**Und wieso gerade Helga?**
Du wirst Teil eines 11-köpfigen Teams - bist also keine Nummer, sondern ein Charakter. Wir sind konsensorientiert, arbeiten auf das gleiche Ziel hin und finden die beste Lösung gemeinsam.
Als Unternehmen und Personen entwickeln und bilden wir uns laufend weiter. Du kannst mitreden, deine Arbeit mitgestalten und unsere Zukunft prägen.
**Überzeugt! Wie weiter?**

YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data.
As a Data Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in making that vision a reality. You will own the path from raw alternative data to trusted, product ready intelligence—determining how complex datasets are structured, interpreted, and ultimately surfaced to customers.
This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist.
Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time.

Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design
Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products.
Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted.
Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation.
Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs.
AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems
Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails.
Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers.
Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible.
Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior.
Product Development & Customer Problem Solving
Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities.
Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product.
Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality.
Data Quality & Operational Excellence
Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production.
Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions.
Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences.
Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases.
You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have
3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field.
Strong fluency in SQL; comfort with data pipelines, schema changes, and upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Experience owning data documentation, metric definitions, or data quality programs—not just conducting ad hoc analysis.
A track record of cross-functional coordination, ideally between technical data teams and product or commercial stakeholders.
Strong project management instincts: you can run a triage process, maintain a quality library, and coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups without dropping balls.
Clear, structured communication—you can translate complex data methodology questions into guidance that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
A demonstrable track record of building—shipping things, solving hard problems, and leaving a clear mark on the products you’ve worked on.
An entrepreneurial mindset: you’re comfortable with ambiguity, energized by new problem spaces, and don’t need a fully paved road to make progress.
Deep experience with alternative data, panel data, or similarly complex, nuanced data sources is required—you need to understand the quirks, limitations, and methodological subtleties of these datasets and be able to encode that understanding for an AI driven product.
Prior experience in or exposure to AI/ML products, LLM-based agents, or evaluation frameworks is a strong plus.

You'll own one of Letly's product surfaces end to end — the money surface (rent collection, deposits, landlord payouts, statements and the ledger underneath them) or the marketplace (AI-Native property management, the vendor network and the embedded products sold into a tenancy) — the product and the operation running on it.
We don't sell software to this industry, we run the industry ourselves: every product decision you make lands in a real tenancy, a real payment and a real operator's day, usually within the week.
These are mid-to-senior hires. At mid you own a surface and ship it. At senior you own a surface others depend on — you set the product patterns, take the architecture-shaped calls with engineering, and raise the bar around you.
What you'll own
The console the business runs on. The internal surface ops actually works in, whichever side you own. Every hour of manual work you design out is margin.

Rent in. Collection across thousands of tenancies — mandates, retries, part-payments and arrears — and the tenant-facing product wrapped around it.
Money out. Landlord payouts, statements, deposits and pooled client money: right to the penny, on the day we promised, compliant, and legible to a landlord who is not an accountant.
The ledger and reconciliation. A penny-accurate, self-healing ledger reconciling bank activity across every tenancy, plus the tooling ops reaches for when it doesn't match.
Money agents in production. Agents that chase arrears, answer "where is my rent", and escalate to a human. You decide what they're allowed to do, what the guardrails are, and where the handover sits.

AI-Native property management. The managed product itself — maintenance, compliance, renewals, inspections — run by agents with humans only on the exceptions, across the service ladder from self-managing to guaranteed.
The vendor network. Supply on the services side: contractors, engineers, cleaners, inventory clerks, photographers. Onboarding, pricing, SLAs, quality controls, and the routing that picks the right one without a human in the middle.
Embedded products. Insurance, compliance certificates, referencing and utilities sold into the tenancy at the moment they're needed — attach rate, take-rate and the unit economics of each.
The landlord and tenant journey. Listing → viewing → offer → referencing → contract → tenancy → renewal, built as one product across both sides of a transaction that has never been one product.
How we work
You get your own answers — query the data, read the tickets, sit with ops, do the job manually once before you specify it.
You use AI across your own work: research, specs, prototypes, analysis. We expect a PM to operate AI-Natively and run product operations.
Weekly release cadence, decisions written down, evidence over opinion.

Job Description
At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes

Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first
Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.
Operating as an AI-native Product Manager

Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.
Collaborating across teams
Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.
Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.
Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.

This role starts on the content platform, and the platform surface it serves is growing. The foundations of the company, identity and access, developer platform, data and the infrastructure everything runs on, are being invested in over the coming year. We are looking for someone whose curiosity does not stop at the edge of their own team, because the interesting problems here sit exactly where those layers meet.
There is genuine ambiguity in this space right now, and a decision or two you would inherit that we have not finished making. We would rather tell you that than have you discover it in month two. The upside is that very little here is set, so the person who takes this shapes the layer everything else in the product is built on for the next several years.

Own the content services every surface depends on. The services and APIs that serve content to the learner surface, the admin surface and everything we build next, plus the delivery path including CDN and video, and file and asset storage.
Own the structural contract. How content is stored, versioned and served so it can be reused and assembled differently for different customers. This is a schema and interface problem before it is a tooling problem, and your measure is whether the contract other teams build against is clear, stable and safe to change.
Own multi tenant separation. Making sure one customer’s content and branding stay theirs. The tenancy model needs a decision and an owner, and that will be one of your first real pieces of work.
Own access, entitlements and data residency. Who can reach what, where data lives, and what we are able to commit to contractually.
Own performance and cost per tenant. If this layer is slow, everything is slow. If it is expensive, it is expensive everywhere.
Carry the platform half of a migration already in flight. We are moving off an incumbent content tool while the current system keeps earning. Sequencing that is the real work, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Own the non functional questions that show up in deals. A meaningful share of our deals slow down in security and compliance review rather than in the pitch, and that is a product problem with a revenue number attached.

s.h: This role is for you if you have
s.t:
Experience with content management as a product, whether that is a CMS, a DAM, a headless content platform or a structured content system at scale. This is our primary preference.
Experience owning platform or infrastructure adjacent product, where success was measured in what other teams could build rather than in features a customer names.
Enough technical depth to be useful and the honesty to say where you are not. You can read an architecture proposal, ask the question that unpicks it, and tell the difference between a researched answer and a fluent one.
The ability to hold your own with senior engineers, infrastructure engineers and security specialists. Not as a peer on implementation, but well enough that a remediation estimate or a tenancy design does not go unchallenged. A previous career as an engineer is a real advantage and not a requirement.
A habit of thinking in seams. Where systems meet, what a contract between them should guarantee, and how to keep a decision reversible rather than walking through a one way door.
The ability to sequence. We are modernising a platform that carries real history while it keeps earning, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Writing. Decisions, tradeoffs and the reasoning behind them, in a way an engineer and an executive can both act on.
Nice to have, and genuinely useful: depth in AI and personalisation, or in infrastructure. Either one compounds with this role, and we are not expecting both.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You want to be a delivery manager for the engineers. They are strong and they do not need coordinating. They need decisions and clarity about what matters.
You want to own the authoring and editorial experience itself. A colleague owns that, you will work closely with them, and drawing the seam between you well is part of the job.
You want to run a rewrite programme. Foundations serve outcomes, and a foundation with no customer outcome attached does not get funded here and should not.
You need the surrounding decisions settled before you arrive.

We are growing this team while it delivers, on a platform with real history, and some of what we currently believe will turn out to be wrong. The incumbent HR suites are consolidating and buying their way into this space, so the clock is real.
The problem underneath it is genuinely unsolved. Nobody has built software that knows what a person needs to be able to do next week, teaches it in the few minutes they actually have, and observes whether it landed without asking them. Not the language apps, which have the habit but not the stakes. Not the platforms, which have the content but not the attention. Not the HR suites, which have the data but have never made anything a person voluntarily opens.
If that sounds like a problem worth several years, we should talk.
As our Senior Product Manager for the learner experience, you own the surface where learning actually happens, for the person actually doing it. It is the most visible product role in the company, because everything else in our strategy depends on somebody coming back on a Tuesday. Today weekly active learners sits close to one percent. That number is the job.

Own the learner surface end to end. Onboarding, what someone is offered next, how it arrives, and what we learn from what they did.
Move us from a catalogue people browse to a product that pays attention. Personalisation here is a spectrum, not a feature: country and industry, company size, whether they reach us through their own LMS or directly, then company, department, team and finally the individual. A fifteen minute bus ride should be able to become seven minutes of audio and three quick questions, assembled for that person.
Partner with our educational designers on how it reaches one person. They have decades of research behind how our content is built, in activities of two to eight minutes designed for habit formation. What is not yet settled is how those pieces compose into a path for one person, and you would be one of the people settling it.

Your half is the one they cannot do on their own: how it reaches one specific person, on one specific day, on whatever device they have, and what to offer instead when something did not land.
Own the measurement that makes it real. Weekly active learners is the number this role moves. There is a baseline. Setting the target with us, and owning the path to it, is part of the job.
Treat mobile as a first class question rather than a port. Seven minutes attached to a real week is a phone experience far more often than a desk one. Whether that is a native client or something lighter is a genuine open decision with very different costs.
Draw on a single library. Our own studio content, customer created content and content generated on the spot all sit together, and deciding what surfaces to whom is part of your job.
This role is for you if you have
A track record owning either a B2B2C product, where the buyer and the user are different people and the user did not choose you, or a consumer habit-formation product built to create usage rather than meet demand that already existed
Evidence you have shipped personalisation, routing or recommendation work that measurably changed behaviour, and the scar tissue to know how often it does not
Comfort on a platform that carries real history. You will build the new thing while the old thing earns the revenue, and sequencing that is part of the craft rather than an obstacle to it
A habit of deciding. You gather input properly and then take the call, and you can say clearly what you are not doing and why
A habit of working in the open. Drafts early, thinking visible, and you would rather be corrected on Tuesday than right on Friday
A genuine interest in how people learn. You do not need a background in it, you do need to find it interesting, because you will work closely with people who have spent careers on it
Comfort partnering with an embedded engineering manager on the team rather than managing engineers directly
This role is not for you if
You want a clean greenfield. That is a much easier engineering problem and a much worse bet, and it is not what this is
You need the strategy finished before you start. It is being written now and you would be one of the people writing it
You want to run the roadmap process. Product Operations owns that craft, this role owns the outcome
You would rather own a feature area than a number
You expect to set every priority yourself from day one. A leadership-set integration into the current platform is already on the roadmap when you arrive, yours to execute well, not to re-litigate

## Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Mikrochirurgie mit uns! ##
Synovis Micro, Teil der Baxter-Gruppe, zählt zu den weltweit führenden Anbietern innovativer Lösungen für die Mikrochirurgie. Unsere Technologien kommen insbesondere in der plastisch-rekonstruktiven Chirurgie, Handchirurgie sowie der Kopf-Hals-Chirurgie zum Einsatz und haben sich in zahlreichen Kliniken als Standard etabliert.
Mit einem starken Distributorennetzwerk in 22 europäischen Ländern begleiten wir medizinische Fachkräfte, Vertriebspartner und Gesundheitseinrichtungen bei der erfolgreichen Einführung und Anwendung unserer innovativen Lösungen.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

s.h: AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI
s.t:
BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.
As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass , while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.
The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass .

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role.

You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds.

Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you
accordingly.

Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.

· Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.

· Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.

· Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.

· Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.

· Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.

· Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
